properties.displayName: UAV S17 - SAR Target Coordinate Exfiltration (Outside Authorized Area)
properties.description: UAVSarPayload_CL 표적 좌표가 UAVC4I_CL 허가구역(AreaRadiusM, meter단위) 밖인 경우 탐지. 실제 컬럼: MissionId 없음→UAVId 연결, AreaRadius는 AreaRadiusM(meter). MITRE: T1020 Automated Exfiltration
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
let AuthArea = UAVC4I_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AreaLat, AreaLon, AreaRadiusM) by UAVId=Callsign;
UAVSarPayload_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| join kind=leftouter (AuthArea) on UAVId
| extend distM = geo_distance_2points(
    toreal(TargetLon), toreal(TargetLat),
    toreal(AreaLon), toreal(AreaLat))
| extend isOutside = isnotnull(AreaLat) and distM > toreal(AreaRadiusM)
| summarize FrameCount=count(), OutsideCount=countif(isOutside),
    MaxDistM=max(distM), UAVId=any(UAVId)
    by FrameId, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where OutsideCount > 0 or FrameCount > 100
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    OutsideCount > 0, strcat("SAR_허가구역_외_", tostring(OutsideCount), "건_최대거리_", tostring(toint(MaxDistM)), "m"),
    strcat("SAR_프레임_버스트_", tostring(FrameCount), "건/5min"))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, FrameId, FrameCount, OutsideCount, MaxDistM, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S17 - SAR Target Coordinate Exfiltration (Outside Authorized Area) - {{UAVId}}
